body:
Minecraft Username: Bloodoh


Discord ID: Bloodoh#0057


In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: Im Max, I have 15 years old and i live in Argentina, I like to help my friends and to support everything that i love doing, this is an example.


What is your Twitter account?: @max_sus


Have you ever used Tweetdeck before?: Yes, I have used it, I thought it would be quicker and simpler than Twitter but I was wrong, it was too complicated in my opinion, i prefer using just the normal Twitter app.


Have you ever marketed something using twitter before?: No I didn't, but I have administrated a lot of Twitter accounts of organizations and esports team so I know how to be "sellouty" 


What is one weakness you know you have?: The worst weakness that I have is that I usually write the tweets longer than I should do. Im in need of more characters usually.


By the way the good thing of this is that i can do Spanish tweets and "advertise" more for the spanish community to make it easier to read.
